note: Planner map types. Online ones need Internet and are off the course network; the OCS display itself never loads them. Google and Bing are the same tile servers Mission Planner's GMap.NET uses (no key, unofficial, may be rate-limited). {z}/{x}/{y} tile numbers, {q} Bing quadkey, {s} one of 'subdomains'. geocoder: place-name lookup for 'Go to' (logic 12, MP uses OpenStreetMap's geocoder too); online only, coordinates work without it. places: Go-to shortcuts {name: [lat, lng]}, work offline; RMK is built in (planner default view).
